text:
samira: :wave: Heads-up — Product needs a Console comparison view for Hosted vs Dedicated GPU capacity. Key asks: SM occupancy, per-SM memory headroom, queue depth + tail latency. We need runtime + infra telemetry stitched. Who owns metric defs and ingest?

kai: I can own the schema + runtime tags. Need a final metric list and label invariants. Quick question: do we need per-tenant breakdown for Dedicated? that impacts cardinality.

anil: For Dedicated customers will expect tenant-level breakdown and reserved_pool tag. But we should cap cardinality: propose top-N tenants + an "other" bucket by default.

diane: @kai can runtime emit sm-level metrics? current runtime has `gpu.sm.occupancy_pct` but no `sm_id`. We need SM granularity for the heatmap.

kai: Yes we can add `sm_id` and basics: `sm_mem_total_bytes`, `sm_mem_free_bytes`. Also propose a convenience metric `gpu.sm.memory_headroom_bytes = sm_mem_free_bytes`. Runtime change will need a canary rollout.

jess: UX notes: Console should show pool-level heatmap, per-tenant rollups for Dedicated, region and model_variant filters for Hosted. Include queue-depth percentiles (P50/P95/P99) and a small timeline view for tail-latency spikes. Alerts: per-pool and per-tenant thresholds.

anil: Telemetry sources: runtime (latency/queue histograms), node agent (GPU memory totals), slotmgr (slot-level mapping). Runtime already exposes `gpu.queue.depth` and histogram `gpu.queue.wait_seconds_bucket`. We need to align label names: `pool`, `pool_type` (hosted|dedicated), `tenant_id` (opt), `instance`, `sm_id`, `slot_kind`.

samira: Action items: 1) define canonical metric list, 2) lock labels + cardinality policy, 3) infra/agent work to expose missing fields, 4) dashboard owner + rollout plan. Can we sketch metric names here?

kai: Suggested metric set:
```
# occupancy and memory
gpu.sm.occupancy_pct{pool, pool_type, instance, sm_id, model_variant}
gpu.sm.memory_total_bytes{pool, instance, sm_id}
gpu.sm.memory_free_bytes{pool, instance, sm_id}
# composite convenience
gpu.sm.memory_headroom_bytes{pool, instance, sm_id}
# queue
gpu.queue.depth{pool, pool_type, slot_kind, tenant_id?}
gpu.queue.wait_seconds_bucket{pool, pool_type, slot_kind, tenant_id?}
# aggregated
gpu.pool.occupancy_pct_avg{pool, pool_type}
```
Labels with `?` are optional for Hosted vs Dedicated. Keep tenant_id only for Dedicated and gated by sampling config.

diane: :eyes: I'll take dashboard ownership (Console). Rollout plan: staging canary on Dedicated dev pool -> 1-week observation -> expand to Hosted staging. Need sampling defaults: tenant_id only for top-100 tenants or `sample_rate=0.05` otherwise. Also we should expose a tag `telemetry_version` to support rollbacks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard `gpu-occupancy-stitchup` created in staging workspace (canary=1).

jess: I'll open a doc with wireframes and add recommended alert buckets (mem_headroom per-SM < X, queue depth > Y for >Z seconds). Also propose adding a cost-sampling flag so we can gate high-cardinality ingestion and estimate traffic.

samira: :+1: I'll write the short RFC and tag infra/observability. Next sync: please add comments on the doc before EOD tomorrow. Thanks!
